Supporting a Japanese institution’s global trading transformation

Connecting requirements across markets and business functions.

The objective

Improve trading processes and reduce operational risk through a derivatives-platform deployment at a Japanese financial institution.

Mak’s contribution

Mak led a global team of more than 60 people to design processes and define business requirements across five markets and front-, middle- and back-office functions.

The outcome

The CV reports enhanced trading processes and reduced operational risk. Specific measures and the final deployment scope remain to be established.

Source: Makarand Datar’s account.

The experience this brings

Working with a Japanese institution and coordinating complex requirements across functions and markets.
